description: India Trader: suggestion-only trading skills for NSE stocks

plugins.name: trader-skill
plugins.description: Nine Claude skills for Indian stocks: a NIFTY 500 scanner (intraday and swing), news with BSE filings, an entry timer, an exit planner on NSE ticks, a time machine scored after Indian charges, sizing with rule checks, alerts with the NSE calendar, a journal that keeps score, and a one-card suggestion. Never places orders.
